title: 第18章：空手套白狼
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“阿姨，我还有个不情之请。”

    “你说，是什么事？”

    “我想从你这里进一点服装回去卖。”

    “卖？”

    苏雨琪马上跳出来，“小超，你是不是疯了，我妈进的这些卖都卖不掉。”

    马超看着她一脸着急替自己惋惜的模样，只是无奈失笑，心底稳得很，半点没有慌乱。

    苏妈妈也面露诧异，顺着角落的货堆扫了一眼，语气带着几分无奈：“是啊小超，这批货压在店里快一年了。都是前年、大前年的复古老款，清一色的确良衬衣、厚款卡其布外套，还有几百捆囤货的尼龙袜。现在城里年轻人都穿新潮款式，这些老物件根本没人看，我正愁砸手里处理不掉，你拿来卖，真的太冒险了。”

    “阿姨放心，我心里有数。”马超语气沉稳笃定，“城里人嫌款式老旧土气，可我们乡下不一样。老家那边物资匮乏，老百姓就喜欢这种料子扎实、耐穿耐看的衣服，花哨新款他们反倒不习惯、不敢穿。这些货放我老家，绝对是刚需。”

    苏雨琪撇撇嘴，眨巴着大眼睛，依旧满脸不解，小声嘟囔道：“放着好看的新款不做，非要捡没人要的旧货，真搞不懂你怎么想的。”

    她顿了顿，报出了实打实的清仓价格，贴合当下实体店尾货行情：“全新带吊牌的的确良衬衣，我给你25块一件；加厚卡其布外套，用料足、版型正，35块一件；成捆的尼龙袜，一捆十双，我直接8块钱一捆给你。这价格，我纯粹是清库存，一分钱利润都没有。”

    话音刚落，苏雨琪瞬间急了，一把拉住苏妈妈的胳膊，急得直跺脚：“妈！你这也太亏了！咱们的确良衬衣进价就要四十五六，卡其外套进价快六十，尼龙袜一双进价一块五，一捆成本都十五了！你这价格连进价本钱都兜不住，纯亏本啊！”

    苏妈妈轻轻拍了拍女儿的手背，神色淡然：“我知道亏本。但这批货占着库房位置，放得越久越陈旧，最后只能当废品处理。与其彻底烂掉，不如低价清给小超，还能回点资金。”

    马超听着母女俩的对话，心里透亮，连忙上前一步，神色格外诚恳：“阿姨，我知道您是心疼我，特意亏本让利照顾我。但我真不能让您做赔本买卖，生意归生意，人情归人情。”

    他目光仔细扫过整齐堆放的衣物，眼底藏着难以掩饰的火热，继续说道：“我仔细看过了，这批的确良面料平整耐磨、不皱易洗，在我们那边是抢手好货，随便摆摊都能卖出去。还有这些尼龙袜，结实耐穿、弹力足，乡下干农活、日常穿都合适，根本不愁销路。”

    马超坦然点头，语气十分笃定：“阿姨，您这个价格很公道，完全没问题，我认可。”

    苏妈妈见他爽快，笑着松了口气：“认可就好，阿姨也不赚你一分钱，纯粹清库存。那你看大概要多少货，阿姨给你清点打包。”

    马超张了张嘴，话到嘴边又顿住，脸上浮出一抹无奈的苦笑。

    “不过……”

    这一声转折，让苏妈妈和苏雨琪都是一愣，下意识看向他。

    马超坦然迎上两人的目光，不遮掩、不尴尬，老实开口：“阿姨，我跟您说实话，价格我百分百认可，也真心想拿下这批货，但是我……暂时拿不出这么多钱。”

    这话一出，店内瞬间安静下来。
content_en:
"Auntie, I have a favor to ask you."

    "Tell me, what is it?"

    "I want to buy some clothes from you and sell them back."

    "Sell?"

    Su Yuqi jumped out immediately, "Xiaochao, are you crazy? My mother can't sell these."

    Ma Chao looked at her anxious expression and felt sorry for him, but he just laughed helplessly, feeling very calm in his heart and not panicking at all.

    Mother Su also looked surprised. She glanced at the pile of goods in the corner and said with a bit of helplessness: "Yes, Xiaochao, this batch of goods has been in the store for almost a year. They are all vintage models from the year before and the year before that, and they are all good quality shirts. "

    "Don't worry, Auntie, I know what I know." Ma Chao said in a calm and determined tone, "People in the city think the styles are old and rustic, but we are different in the countryside. There is a lack of supplies in my hometown, and the people like this kind of clothes that are made of solid materials and are durable and durable. They are not used to the fancy new styles and dare not wear them. These goods are definitely needed in my hometown."

    Su Yuqi curled her lips, blinked her big eyes, and still had a puzzled look on her face. She muttered in a low voice: "I don't want to make new and beautiful products, but I insist on picking up old ones that no one wants. I really don't understand what you think."

    She paused and quoted a real clearance price, which was in line with the current sale of goods in physical stores: "I will give you 25 yuan for a brand-new, good-quality shirt with a tag; 35 yuan for a thickened khaki jacket with sufficient materials and the right fit; and 8 yuan for a bundle of ten pairs of nylon socks. At this price, I am purely clearing out inventory, and there is no profit at all."

    As soon as she finished speaking, Su Yuqi became anxious. She grabbed Su's mother's arm and stamped her feet anxiously: "Mom! You are at such a loss! Our Doliang shirts cost just forty-five-six, our khaki jackets cost almost sixty, a pair of nylon socks cost one and a half, and the cost of a bundle is already fifteen! You can't even cover the purchase cost at this price, you are totally losing money!"

    Mother Su gently patted the back of her daughter's hand, with an indifferent expression: "I know I'm losing money. But this batch of goods occupies space in the warehouse, and the longer it is kept, the older it becomes. In the end, it can only be treated as scrap. Instead of completely rotting, it is better to sell it to Xiaochao at a low price and get some funds back."

    Ma Chao listened to the conversation between mother and daughter, and his heart became clear. He quickly stepped forward with a particularly sincere expression: "Auntie, I know you feel sorry for me and are taking care of me at a loss. But I really can't let you do a loss-making business. Business is business, and favor is favor."

    His eyes carefully scanned the neatly stacked clothes, and there was an unconcealable passion in his eyes, and he continued: "I have looked carefully. This batch of good-quality fabrics is flat, wear-resistant, wrinkle-free and easy to wash. It is a hot commodity here and can be sold at any stall. These nylon socks are strong, durable and elastic. They are suitable for farm work in the countryside and daily wear. There is no need to worry about sales."

    Ma Chao nodded calmly and said in a very firm tone: "Auntie, your price is very fair. There is no problem at all. I agree."

    Seeing that he was happy, Mother Su smiled and breathed a sigh of relief: "As long as you agree, Auntie won't make any money from you. She just clears the inventory. Then you can see how much goods you need, and Auntie will count and pack them for you."

    Ma Chao opened his mouth, then paused as he spoke, with a helpless smile on his face.

    "But..."

    This turn of events made Su's mother and Su Yuqi stunned, and they subconsciously looked at him.

    Ma Chao met their gazes calmly, without covering up or embarrassment, and spoke honestly: "Auntie, let me tell you the truth. I 100% agree with the price, and I really want to get this batch of goods, but I... can't afford so much money for the time being."

    As soon as these words came out, the store instantly became quiet.
